content.json:
# CISA KEV to MDVM Findings Correlation

Correlates CISA's [Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog](https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog) - CVEs confirmed to be actively exploited in the wild - against live Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management (MDVM) findings from every onboarded device in the tenant.

Use this workbook to:
- See exactly **which KEV CVEs are present on which devices right now**, with the CVE name, affected software, severity, and CISA-mandated remediation due date.
- Prioritize patching by **ransomware association** (CVEs CISA flags as used in known ransomware campaigns) and by **BOD due date** (Past Due / Due < 14d).
- Identify the **most exposed devices** and the **software products driving the most KEV exposure**, so remediation effort lands where it removes the most risk.

**Data source:** Native Microsoft Defender XDR Advanced Hunting tables (`DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities` and `DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilitiesKB`). No custom Log Analytics table, Logic App, or Data Collection Rule is required. CISA comparison panels intentionally use only the CISA feed and `DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities`; CVSS enrichment remains on the All CVEs view so no query combines more than two sources. After import, select the Sentinel workspace when prompted by the workbook's **Advanced hunting** data source.

Drafting assistance: Claude Opus 4.8 (via GitHub Copilot), grounded in official Microsoft Learn documentation.

parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.label: Device
parameters.query: {"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities\r\n| distinct DeviceName\r\n| order by DeviceName asc","selectedWorkspaceIds":[]}

parameters.name: CveId
parameters.label: CVE ID
parameters.query: {"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities\r\n| distinct CveId\r\n| order by CveId asc","selectedWorkspaceIds":[]}

parameters.name: VulnerabilityName
parameters.label: Vulnerability name (CISA)

parameters.name: VendorProject
parameters.label: Vendor (CISA)

parameters.name: Product
parameters.label: Product (CISA)

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"let CISA_KEV = externaldata(cveID:string, vendorProject:string, product:string, vulnerabilityName:string, dateAdded:datetime, shortDescription:string, requiredAction:string, dueDate:datetime, knownRansomwareCampaignUse:string, notes:string, cwes:string)[@'https://www.cisa.gov/sites/default/files/csv/known_exploited_vulnerabilities.csv'] with (format='csv', ignoreFirstRecord=true);
let KEV = CISA_KEV
  | where vulnerabilityName in ({VulnerabilityName}) or '*' in ({VulnerabilityName})
  | where vendorProject in ({VendorProject}) or '*' in ({VendorProject})
  | where product in ({Product}) or '*' in ({Product})
  | project CveId=cveID, dueDate, knownRansomwareCampaignUse
  | join kind=inner hint.strategy=broadcast (
      DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
      | where DeviceName in ({DeviceName}) or '*' in ({DeviceName})
      | where CveId in ({CveId}) or '*' in ({CveId})
      | project DeviceName, CveId
    ) on CveId;
let Stats = KEV
  | summarize KEVMatches=count(), UniqueCVEs=dcount(CveId), AffectedDevices=dcount(DeviceName), RansomwareCVEs=dcountif(CveId, knownRansomwareCampaignUse != 'Unknown'), PastDue=countif(dueDate < now());
Stats
| mv-expand Metric=pack_array('KEV Matches','Unique CVEs','Affected Devices','Ransomware CVEs','Past Due') to typeof(string), Value=pack_array(KEVMatches, UniqueCVEs, AffectedDevices, RansomwareCVEs, PastDue) to typeof(long)
| project Metric, Value","selectedWorkspaceIds":[]}

{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"let CISA_KEV = externaldata(cveID:string, vendorProject:string, product:string, vulnerabilityName:string, dateAdded:datetime, shortDescription:string, requiredAction:string, dueDate:datetime, knownRansomwareCampaignUse:string, notes:string, cwes:string)[@'https://www.cisa.gov/sites/default/files/csv/known_exploited_vulnerabilities.csv'] with (format='csv', ignoreFirstRecord=true);
CISA_KEV
| where vulnerabilityName in ({VulnerabilityName}) or '*' in ({VulnerabilityName})
| where vendorProject in ({VendorProject}) or '*' in ({VendorProject})
| where product in ({Product}) or '*' in ({Product})
| project CveId=cveID, vulnerabilityName, shortDescription, vendorProject, product, dueDate, knownRansomwareCampaignUse
| join kind=inner hint.strategy=broadcast (
    DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
    | where DeviceName in ({DeviceName}) or '*' in ({DeviceName})
    | where CveId in ({CveId}) or '*' in ({CveId})
    | project DeviceName, CveId, SoftwareName, SoftwareVersion, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, RecommendedSecurityUpdate, RecommendedSecurityUpdateId
) on CveId
| extend DaysUntilDue=datetime_diff('day', dueDate, now())
| extend DueStatus=case(DaysUntilDue < 0, 'Past Due', DaysUntilDue < 14, 'Due < 14d', 'Due > 14d'), SeverityRank=case(VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == 'Critical', 4, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == 'High', 3, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == 'Medium', 2, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == 'Low', 1, 0), SecurityUpdateAvailable=isnotempty(RecommendedSecurityUpdateId) or isnotempty(RecommendedSecurityUpdate)
| sort by DueStatus asc, SeverityRank desc
| project ['Device Name']=DeviceName, ['CVE ID']=CveId, Vulnerability=vulnerabilityName, Description=shortDescription, Vendor=vendorProject, Product=product, Software=SoftwareName, Version=SoftwareVersion, Severity=VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, ['Ransomware Use']=knownRansomwareCampaignUse, ['Due Date']=dueDate, ['Due Status']=DueStatus, ['Recommended Update']=RecommendedSecurityUpdate, ['Update Available']=SecurityUpdateAvailable","selectedWorkspaceIds":[]}
content.title: Active KEV findings (all devices)

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"let CISA_KEV = externaldata(cveID:string, vendorProject:string, product:string, vulnerabilityName:string, dateAdded:datetime, shortDescription:string, requiredAction:string, dueDate:datetime, knownRansomwareCampaignUse:string, notes:string, cwes:string)[@'https://www.cisa.gov/sites/default/files/csv/known_exploited_vulnerabilities.csv'] with (format='csv', ignoreFirstRecord=true);
CISA_KEV
| where vulnerabilityName in ({VulnerabilityName}) or '*' in ({VulnerabilityName})
| where vendorProject in ({VendorProject}) or '*' in ({VendorProject})
| where product in ({Product}) or '*' in ({Product})
| project CveId=cveID
| join kind=inner hint.strategy=broadcast (
    DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
    | where DeviceName in ({DeviceName}) or '*' in ({DeviceName})
    | where CveId in ({CveId}) or '*' in ({CveId})
    | project DeviceName, CveId
) on CveId
| summarize ['KEV Count']=dcount(CveId) by ['Device Name']=DeviceName
| top 10 by ['KEV Count'] desc","selectedWorkspaceIds":[]}
content.title: Top 10 devices by KEV count

CISA_KEV
| where vulnerabilityName in ({VulnerabilityName}) or '*' in ({VulnerabilityName})

| where product in ({Product}) or '*' in ({Product})
| project CveId=cveID
| join kind=inner hint.strategy=broadcast (

content.json:
### All CVE Exposure
All current vulnerabilities from the native `DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities` table - not filtered to CISA KEVs.

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| summarize CVECount=dcount(CveId), CriticalCount=dcountif(CveId, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == 'Critical'), HighCount=dcountif(CveId, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == 'High'), MediumCount=dcountif(CveId, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == 'Medium'), LowCount=dcountif(CveId, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == 'Low') by DeviceName
| project deviceName=DeviceName, CVECount, CriticalCount, HighCount, MediumCount, LowCount
| sort by CVECount desc","selectedWorkspaceIds":[]}
content.title: CVE Count by Device

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| summarize CVECount=dcount(CveId) by VulnerabilitySeverityLevel
| project vulnerabilitySeverityLevel=VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, CVECount
| sort by CVECount desc","selectedWorkspaceIds":[]}
content.title: CVEs by Severity

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| summarize CVECount=dcount(CveId), Devices=dcount(DeviceName) by SoftwareName, SoftwareVendor
| project softwareName=SoftwareName, softwareVendor=SoftwareVendor, CVECount, Devices
| sort by CVECount desc
| take 20","selectedWorkspaceIds":[]}
